annotation.title_clean: General Policy for the Use of Artificial Intelligence
annotation.title_en: General Policy for the Use of Artificial Intelligence
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Information & eGovernment Authority (iGA), Kingdom of Bahrain
annotation.summary_en: Bahrain's iGA General Policy for the Use of AI (v1.0, approved 20 May 2025) binds government entities to eleven principles and four pillars: legal compliance, adoption, awareness and education, and cooperation. It requires human oversight, audits, and responsibility resting on people rather than machines. It contains no robotics-specific provisions.
key_provisions_or_claims: Applies to all Bahraini government entities; approved by the MCICT on 20 May 2025
Eleven principles including human control, safety, fairness, transparency, accountability, privacy and innovation
Entities must comply with the Personal Data Protection Law, cybercrime law, open data policy and GCC AI Ethics Guideline
Entities must coordinate AI adoption with iGA, conduct regular audits, and keep human oversight with responsibility attributed to individuals
Calls for training programmes and local and international cooperation
